profile.headline: Web Engineer at Skydance | TypeScript, React | HBO Max
profile.summary:
Web engineer at Warner Bros. Discovery, building the HBO Max and discovery+ web clients.

I also worked in the observability metrics platform. I worked on CloudWatch metric collection, Grafana datasources and the IAM roles behind them, a shared alerting-module rollout, and Bolt log retention.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
-12-Week Internship where I was placed in the Release Engineering Team(Dev Ops)
- Project involved designing and developing an automated workflow for submitting new apple clients to app store connect so that it can reviewed for submission. 
- Engaged with Release Team to develop Jira tickets needed to complete the project in a timely manner
- Worked with Golang Programming Language, GitHub Actions, Bazel, and Apple Store Connect API
- Showcased Project to clients, release team, and WBD Executives
- Cut the IOS App Submission Process Time by 80%
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub · Go (Programming Language) · Bazel · Agile Application Development · Lucidchart

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- 11 week internship where I was placed in DSG's Customer engagement team that develops front-end software for their e-commerce websites.
- Developed 3 brand new UI components for the company to reuse
- Some Components were built using Angular.js and the rest with React
- Completed tickets received by DSG's marketing team
